jobs.description: Postdoctoral research fellow 'Computational neurophysiology of human motivation'We are looking for a postdoctoral researcher with expertise and interest in the computational neuroscience of human motivation and cognitive control. The goal of the project is to unravel the neurophysiological signatures of value-based decision making and controllability.The project will involve experimental design, data acquisition, and advanced statistical and computational modeling of neurophysiological (iEEG, single-neuron activity and local field potentials from micro-electrode recordings) and behavioral data from human volunteers and clinical patients.You will play a key role in the ERC Advanced CHEMCONTROL team, led by Roshan Cools, at Donders which comprises research master students, research assistants, 2 PhD students and a senior postdoc. The CHEMCONTROL team will integrate computational modeling, human neurophysiology, pharmacological fMRI, chemical PET imaging, and focused transcranial ultrasound stimulation to unravel the brain mechanisms by which we adapt flexibly to the threats and opportunities around us.You are expected to have the background knowledge, skills and motivation that will allow you to fully exploit and learn from the rich research environment that the Donders Institute provides (including its intellectual and technical infrastructure). You are an independent scholar and brain scientist with quantitative skills and expertise in the domain of human motivation, decision making, learning, and cognitive control. You are ready to acquire the skills required for conducting all phases of computational neuroimaging and neurophysiology, including conceptual and experimental design, computational modeling of behavior, data acquisition, data analysis, data interpretation and publication. You are also expected to be a team player, willing and able to work closely with multiple research group leaders, postdocs, fellows PhD students, research assistants and research master students.You have a passion for mechanistic research at the interface of neurophysiology, computational cognitive science, and decision neuroscience. You are curious, ambitious, and can work independently. Your English is fluent in speaking and writing at an academic level. Speaking Dutch is not required for this position.You also meet the following requirements:You hold or have finished and nearly obtained a PhD in the field of computational cognitive neuroscience, biomedical engineering, or a related field;You have experience and skills in neurophysiological data analyses;You have experience with, or are interested in, computational and statistical modelling of behavioral data;You have excellent programming skills and a strong quantitative background.This position requires a Certificate of Conduct (VOG).

Start your career in European inland shipping with Vario Shipping Group Would you like to start a career in inland shipping, even if you do not yet have a Boatman qualification? Vario Shipping Group is looking for motivated candidates from Slovakia who would like to join our vessels and develop towards becoming a qualified Boatman in European inland shipping. You do not need to be a qualified Boatman when you apply. We are looking for people with the right motivation, attitude and willingness to learn. Your role on board As a member of our deck crew, you will be involved in the safe and efficient daily operation of the vessel. • Mooring and unmooring the vessel • Deck work and general maintenance • Assisting with loading and unloading operations • Keeping the vessel and working areas clean, organised and safe • Following safety procedures and instructions from the Captain • Working together with colleagues from different nationalities • Supporting the crew in the daily operation of the vessel As you gain experience and qualifications, your responsibilities can grow with you. Who are we looking for? We are looking for someone who: • Is motivated to work in European inland shipping • Is comfortable working and living on board for several weeks at a time • Is practical, responsible and safety-conscious • Enjoys working as part of an international team • Is willing to learn and develop professionally • Has sufficient English to communicate safely and effectively on board Experience in inland shipping, maritime work or a technical environment is an advantage, but not essential for every candidate. Vario Shipping Group will support you in finding an appropriate training route and in your further professional development.
